# ADR-3103: A09: Log shipping disablement for node pool 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Local-only logs vanish with the node.

## Decision

Fleets MUST NOT allow a log shipping disablement for node pool 7 (A09-7) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Agents are monitored for heartbeat loss.
